command: C:\Windows\System32\WindowsPowerShell\v1.0\powershell.exe -NoProfile -Command '$nodes=Invoke-RestMethod -Uri "http://127.0.0.1:3080/v3/projects/CampusNetwork_02/nodes"; foreach($n in $nodes){$name=$n.node_id; $u1="http://127.0.0.1:3080/v3/projects/CampusNetwork_02/nodes/$name/command?cmd=display%20current-configuration"; $u0="http://127.0.0.1:3080/v3/projects/CampusNetwork-for-perf_02/nodes/$name/command?cmd=display%20current-configuration"; $a=(Invoke-RestMethod -Uri $u1).output -split "`r?`n" | Where-Object {$_ -notmatch "^!Last configuration"}; $b=(Invoke-RestMethod -Uri $u0).output -split "`r?`n" | Where-Object {$_ -notmatch "^!Last configuration"}; $d=Compare-Object -ReferenceObject $b -DifferenceObject $a; if($d){Write-Output "=== $name ==="; $d | ForEach-Object {Write-Output ("{0} {1}" -f $_.SideIndicator,$_.InputObject)}}}'
